thread:
maria-cs: Heads-up — Acme (customer) started getting 403s for rerank + generate right after SCIM onboarding. They said nothing changed on their side. Audit shows tokens were issued but API responses are "insufficient_scope". Repro steps below.

thom-eng: Can you paste the curl + full error body? Also is this a user token or a service account token?

maria-cs: svc acct issued by provisioner-v2. Curl repro:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-medium","input":"why is this 403"}'
```
Error body: `{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing:rerank"}`

maria-cs: Decoded JWT (payload):
```json
{"sub":"svc-acct:acme-app","scopes":"infer,embeddings","exp":1722226944}
```
Note: rerank missing even though customer requested it during SCIM invite.

richard-sso: That rings a bell — last month we shipped an attribute-transformer change in the SCIM pipeline. The transformer has a scan-mode called `strip_unrecognized` that trims values it doesn't recognize. If the incoming attribute has mixed separators (spaces + commas) or nonstandard casing, the normalizer could misclassify "rerank" and drop it.

maria-cs: Where do I find the provisioner logs to confirm? I grepped but only saw the output token scopes set to `infer embeddings` (space-separated) which downstream serializer then turned into comma list but lost the third token.

elaine-ops: SRE-bot ran a quick query: provisioner-v2 mapping for tenant `acme-prod` used the `attribute-transformer:v2` with config `scan_mode=normalize` and `allowlist=[infer,embeddings]` (weirdly missing `rerank`). That explains why the pipeline stripped rerank rather than preserving it.

sre-bot: Incident created: CS-2489 — `svcacct-scope-strip-on-provision`. Assigned: @richard-sso, @tom-eng. Priority: high. ETA for hotfix: ~2h. :rotating_light:

tom-eng: I reproduced in staging. Repro steps: POST SCIM payload with `scopes: "infer, embeddings, rerank"` -> provisioner logs show transform output `scopes: "infer embeddings"` (no comma, no rerank). Patch plan: update transformer to split on `[\s,]+` and consult dynamic allowlist that includes `rerank`. I'll open a tiny PR to change parsing and add unit tests for comma/space combos.

maria-cs: I issued a manual svc key to Acme so customer can continue (we created a temporary key with explicit `infer,embeddings,rerank` scopes). Customer notified. Also advised rotation once tokens are reissued.

richard-sso: I'll update the allowlist in prod config and push the parsing fix. After that we'll trigger reprovisioning of svc accounts for affected tenants (CS query will list them). I'll also add a regression test to CI.

elaine-ops: Follow-ups: ensure SCIM docs mention accepted separators and add telemetry rule to detect when output scope counts < input scope counts.

maria-cs: Thanks team — I'll add these notes to the ticket and follow up with the customer about rotation + timeline.

richard-sso: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/provisioner/+/1234 (patch + tests). Will monitor deploy.

sre-bot: Deploy status: provisioner-v2 patch deployed to staging ✅, prod rollout scheduled in 45m.

maria-cs: Marking this thread resolved for CS after prod rollout and token rotations. Will keep ticket open until rotations complete. :white_check_mark:
